answer.rationale: Finance’s 18 % spend cut mandate, the imminent contract expiry, and the line’s 94 % utilisation with no buffer make cost reduction without delivery disruption the priority. memory_c4 shows prior renewals secured real margin gains via benchmarking and term adjustments; memory_c6 shows multi-year volume commitments unlocked lower unit costs without narrowing scope. Negotiating a new multi-year or benchmarked agreement with the incumbent directly targets the 18 % cut while preserving the stability noted in memory_c1 (no migration work or delivery interruption). Switching vendors risks onboarding delays and supply hiccups under the current line constraints; adding a second source does not guarantee the mandated cost reduction; deferral forfeits the immediate cut.
